judges.CENTRE_L0_j1: Yes: these are the zodiac roundels of the Voynich manuscript (Beinecke MS 408), the circular zodiac pages with nude/clothed figures in tubs holding stars and Voynich-script labels.
judges.CENTRE_L0_j2: Yes. After looking at all twelve: the script, nude figures in tubs and rings of stars match the zodiac section of the Voynich manuscript (Beinecke MS 408, about folios 70v-73v). That cycle has no Capricorn or Aquarius and two pages each for Aries and Taurus. I did not use this knowledge to choose the signs, but it agrees with them.
judges.CENTRE_L1_j1: Yes: these look like the zodiac medallions of the Voynich manuscript (Beinecke MS 408), folios f70v-f73v.
judges.CENTRE_L1_j2: Yes: the style (nymphs in barrels or tubs around rings of text, centre medallions with an animal, and the cursive script) looks like the zodiac section of the Voynich manuscript (Beinecke MS 408).
judges.CENTRE_L2_j1: yes, probably: the circular diagrams with small figures in tubs around a central emblem look like the zodiac section of the Voynich manuscript (Beinecke MS 408), but I could not confirm individual pages
judges.CENTRE_L2_j2: Yes, probably: the style (circular diagrams with a central animal or object, rings of text, figures in tubs/barrels, pale washes of green, blue and red) looks like the zodiac pages of the Voynich manuscript (Beinecke MS 408). Moderate confidence given the blur.
judges.CENTRE_L3_j1: Possibly. The style (red quadruped centre, circular diagrams, beige vellum, green/blue/red wash) is consistent with the zodiac medallions of the Voynich manuscript (Beinecke MS 408), but the images are too degraded to be sure.
judges.CENTRE_L3_j2: Possibly: the faded vellum, the small coloured figures arranged around circular diagrams, and the central animals resemble the zodiac section of the Voynich manuscript (Beinecke MS 408), but at this pixelation level this is a guess, not a confident recognition. I did not use this to choose signs.
judges.CENTRE_L4_j1: yes: the tubs/barrels with figures, ring layout and script style suggest the zodiac section of the Voynich manuscript (Beinecke MS 408)
judges.CENTRE_L4_j2: yes, probably: the style (zodiac-type central figures, small figures and script-like text around a circle) looks like the zodiac pages of the Voynich manuscript (Beinecke MS 408), though the degraded images make this uncertain
judges.CENTRE_L5_j1: Yes: the style (nude nymphs in tubs holding stars, concentric text rings in an unknown script, crossbow archer, fish pair) matches the zodiac section of the Voynich manuscript (Beinecke MS 408).
judges.CENTRE_L5_j2: yes - the zodiac section of the Voynich manuscript (Beinecke MS 408), recognised from the script and the nude figures with stars in tubs
judges.FULL_j1: yes: these look like the zodiac pages of the Voynich manuscript (Beinecke MS 408), with its unknown script and star-holding nude or tub-bound figures.
judges.FULL_j2: Yes: these are the zodiac pages of the Voynich manuscript (Beinecke MS 408), recognisable from the script, the nude star-holding women in tubs and the concentric rings.
judges.FULL_j3: yes: the zodiac section of the Voynich manuscript (Beinecke MS 408)
